Subject: Request to shift live demo to allow a dedicated prep week (sample data + runbook)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for confirming the demo next week. After syncing with our infra and product teams, we’d like to ask if we can shift the live demo by one full week. The reason: to run a short prep week that ensures we have the right prompt sets, ingestion of a small sample of your production traces, and a verified read-only access path for the demo environment.

What we need from FinLytics (high level):
- Short sample dataset (anonymized) and a small set of representative workload traces (500–2k lines)
- A read-only S3 or share with a temporary principal we can use for the dry-run
- A list of 4 critical prompts/use-cases you want validated

Attachments: pre-demo-data-checklist.xlsx (fields and anonymization notes), runbook-template.md (dry-run steps we’ll follow).

If we shift by a week it gives us:
- Tue/Wed to ingest and validate the sample data
- Thu for a full dry-run with your SMEs
- Fri for a short executive preview and notes ahead of the public demo

Proposed new live demo window: Tue 2026-11-24 or Wed 2026-11-25 between 10:00–14:00 ET. If those don’t work, suggest alternate times.

I’ve CC’d Marissa (Solutions) to help with the data checklist. Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock internal calendars.

Best,
Lauren Bishop

Suggest we split the difference: we can do a short prep window next week (remote ingest and validation) and keep the public demo the week after, but earlier in that week — e.g., Mon 2026-11-30 or Tue 2026-12-01 mornings ET. If your team can still run a dry-run on Thu 2026-11-19 afternoon, that would help.

I’ll have Olivia coordinate the sample dataset handoff. We can provide an anonymized S3 bucket and an IAM role scoped to read-only for a one-week window.

Availability: Mon 11/30 09:00–11:30 ET, Tue 12/01 10:00–13:00 ET. Prefer the 11/30 slot if possible.

Sam Wells
